acceptanceScenarios.cleanBaselineWrite: clean_baseline_write_round_trips_via_persisted_record: writes a versioned BaselineRecord (Sha256 integrity) via write_baseline, loads it back via load_baseline, asserts round-trip equality
acceptanceScenarios.unchangedRunPasses: unchanged_run_passes_with_warnings: baseline == current -> passes() true, every violation demoted to warning (not dropped)
acceptanceScenarios.oneAddedFindingFails: one_added_finding_fails: current adds one new (file,line) key not in baseline -> passes() false, exactly 1 error, prior 2 still warn, ratcheted baseline grows to 3
acceptanceScenarios.oneGrownCountFails: one_grown_count_fails: current adds a second occurrence line inside an already-baselined file -> passes() false, exactly 1 error at the new line, growth cannot hide behind an already-flagged file
acceptanceScenarios.oneRemovedFindingShrinks: one_removed_finding_shrinks_the_allowance: current drops one baselined key -> passes() true, ratcheted baseline shrinks from 2 to 1; persists the shrink to disk and proves the dropped key fails closed again if reintroduced (no silent re-grandfathering)
